mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_3: One Undo Dye removes the back color from two tile stacks or boxes. Both must have a back color that the dye can remove. If either would remain unchanged, the machine will not run or consume the dye.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_4: A deployer applies Red Dora Dye to 5m, 5p, and 5s tiles one by one on belts or depots. Undo Dye restores them one by one, keeping the back color.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_5: A mixer marks 16 identical blank sticks with a single dye. Use white for 100, blue for 1,000, yellow for 5,000, red for 10,000, and black for −10,000 points.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_production.text_: A mechanical saw cuts 24 blank tiles from each block of material. Six blocks make 144 tiles. A bone block can also be cut into 32 blank point sticks.
Mix black, red, green, blue, and white dye for two Mahjong Dyes. One red dye blends into eight Red Dora Dyes, and one black dye into eight Undo Dyes.
To make a mahjong box, use a deployer to attach leather to a chest, then attach an iron nugget. Finish by pressing it with a mechanical press. This recipe does not need wooden slabs.
Under a mechanical press, place an empty box, 144 identical blank tiles, one Mahjong Dye, and a printing plate, and the machine prints Kansai faces.
The press outputs the full 144-tile box and returns the plate. Send the plate back for the next batch. Material, backs, and names are kept.

A press and basin can also pack tiles, marked point sticks, and dice into a mahjong box. Each type of item must fit in its usual slots, just as when you pack the box by hand. The packed box can go straight into the table.

rules.mchjong.option.abortive_draws.desc: Allows abortive draws such as nine different terminals and honors, four identical first wind discards, four kans, and four riichi declarations.
rules.mchjong.option.agari_yame.descript: Ends the match as soon as the dealer wins the final hand and reaches first place, without a dealer repeat.
rules.mchjong.option.award_final_deposit: Gives any unclaimed riichi-stick deposits left on the table to the overall winner when the match ends.
rules.mchjong.option.bankruptcy.descript: Ends the match the moment any player's points drop below 0. Being at exactly 0 keeps the game going.
rules.mchjong.option.calls_clear_furiten: Clears same-turn furiten as soon as any player makes any call.
rules.mchjong.option.compound_yakuman.de: Adds up the points of every distinct yakuman a winning hand satisfies at once.
rules.mchjong.option.delayed_open_kan_do: Flips the kan-dora indicator for open kans and added kans after the discard, not at the moment the kan is declared.
rules.mchjong.option.double_wind_pair_fu: Scores 4 fu for a pair of double winds (both round and seat wind) instead of the usual 2 fu.
rules.mchjong.option.double_yakuman.desc: Counts suuankou tanki, kokushi musou with a thirteen-sided wait, pure chuuren poutou, and daisuushii as double yakuman.
rules.mchjong.option.extension.descripti: If no player has reached the target score when the final hand ends, the match continues into extra rounds.
Adjusts placement bonuses according to how many players finish at or above the return score.
rules.mchjong.option.floating_uma: %s Players at or Above Return Score: Rank %s Bonus (Points)
rules.mchjong.option.floating_uma.descri: When the number of players at or above return points is %s, the placement bonus for rank %s (in points).
rules.mchjong.option.formal_tenpai_ignor: At an exhaustive draw, a hand can count as tenpai even if its winning tiles are already used up in its own called sets or concealed kans.
rules.mchjong.option.head_bump.descripti: When several players ron the same discard, only the closest one counter-clockwise from the discarder wins.
rules.mchjong.option.ippatsu.description: Adds ippatsu (+1 han) for winning within one uninterrupted turn cycle after declaring riichi.
rules.mchjong.option.ippatsu_counts_towa: Lets ippatsu count toward meeting higher minimum-han requirements.
rules.mchjong.option.kan_dora.descriptio: Flips an additional dora indicator in the dead wall whenever a kan is declared.
rules.mchjong.option.kazoe_yakuman.descr: Scores a winning hand with 13 or more han, including dora, as a counted yakuman rather than sanbaiman.
rules.mchjong.option.kiriage_mangan.desc: Rounds 3-han 60-fu and 4-han 30-fu scores up to a full mangan
rules.mchjong.option.kuitan.description: Allows tanyao (All Simples) after you open your hand with chi, pon, or an open kan.
rules.mchjong.option.match_length.descri: Choose a tonpuusen (East only) or hanchan (East and South) match.
rules.mchjong.option.min_han.description: The lowest han total a win must meet, counting yaku only.
rules.mchjong.option.min_riichi_wall: Minimum Tiles Left to Declare Riichi
rules.mchjong.option.min_riichi_wall.des: The minimum number of drawable tiles left in the wall for riichi to be allowed (usually 4 in standard rules).
rules.mchjong.option.nagashi_allows_call: Allows your own calls without voiding Nagashi Mangan.
rules.mchjong.option.nagashi_mangan.desc: Scores Nagashi Mangan as a mangan tsumo when every discard in your river is an uncalled terminal or honor at an exhaustive draw.
rules.mchjong.option.needs_riichi_deposi: Forbids declaring riichi when holding fewer than 1,000 points.
rules.mchjong.option.pao_ron_honba_by_di: Discarder Pays Honba on Pao Ron
When a liable yakuman is won by ron off another player, that discarder pays the full honba bonus.
rules.mchjong.option.pao_tsumo_honba_sha: Share Honba on Combined Pao Tsumo
Shares the honba payment among all non-winning players when a liable yakuman tsumo compounds with a non-liable one.
rules.mchjong.option.red_fives.descripti: Sets the number of red fives in each suit (characters, circles, and bamboo).
rules.mchjong.option.renhou_mangan.descr: Scores Blessing of Man as a mangan when you ron before your first draw, without any calls.
rules.mchjong.option.replacement_capacit: How many replacement tiles the dead wall reserves (usually 4 in four-player mahjong).
rules.mchjong.option.return_points.descr: Sets the benchmark score for standings. When it differs from the starting points, the gap goes to first place as the oka.
rules.mchjong.option.riichi_kan_keeps_me: A concealed kan after riichi must not change any possible grouping of the hand into sets.
rules.mchjong.option.riichi_kan_keeps_ya: Forbids a concealed kan after riichi that would make an existing yaku disappear.
rules.mchjong.option.rob_concealed_kan.d: Lets Kokushi Musou ron the tile an opponent declares a concealed kan with (robbing the concealed kan).
rules.mchjong.option.rob_north_without_k: In three-player mahjong, lets any non-Kokushi hand waiting on North rob an opponent's extracted North.
rules.mchjong.option.round_shared_placem: Allocate Uma Remainders in Starting Seat Order
Hands out a 100-point remainder in placement calculations starting from the original dealer.
rules.mchjong.option.shared_ranks.descri: Players tied at the end split the placement and oka of the tied ranks evenly, without tiebreaking by dealer order.
rules.mchjong.option.starting_points.des: The points each player starts the match with.
rules.mchjong.option.suukantsu_pao.descr: Assigns pao liability for Suukantsu to whoever feeds the fourth kan to a player who already has three.
rules.mchjong.option.target_points.descr: Sets the minimum score the leader must hold when the final hand ends. Missing it triggers extension winds such as nishiiri or minamiiri.
rules.mchjong.option.triple_ron_draw.des: Declares the hand an abortive draw if three players ron the same discard at once.
rules.mchjong.option.uma.description: The placement bonus for rank %s in raw points (enter e.g. 10000 for +10).
rules.mchjong.option.ura_dora.descriptio: Flips the ura-dora indicators beneath the revealed dora indicators when a riichi hand wins.
rules.mchjong.option.whole_hand_pao.desc: When a liable yakuman compounds with another yakuman, the liable player pays the whole hand's yakuman points.
rules.mchjong.option.yakuless_furiten.de: Passing a tile that completes your hand causes temporary furiten even if you have no qualifying yaku.

sichuan.mchjong.rules.added_kong_after_k: Added Kong After a Kong Counts as a Post-Kong Discard
If an opponent wins on an added kong declared after a replacement draw, the kong still counts as completed and the win is treated as a win on a discard after a kong.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.added_kong_payment: Each opponent who has not yet won pays this amount for an immediate added kong. A delayed added kong earns no payment.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.concealed_kong_pay: Each opponent who has not yet won pays this amount for a concealed kong.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.discard_kong_payme: For a kong claimed from a discard, only the player who discarded the tile pays this amount.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.east_west_long_wal: When enabled, the East and West walls have 14 stacks each, and the North and South walls have 13. When disabled, East and West have 13 each, and North and South have 14.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.fan_cap.descriptio: The base score is 2 raised to the fan total. This setting limits the fan total used in that calculation.

sichuan.mchjong.rules.match_hands.descri: The match ends and final standings are calculated after this many hands. The dealer for each new hand is determined by the previous hand’s result.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.refund_kong_when_n: Refund Kong Payments When Not Ready
When the wall runs out, players who are not ready must return any kong payments they received that have not already been transferred.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.select_first_disca: When choosing your void suit, secretly choose a tile of that suit as your first discard. You must discard that tile first. If you have no tiles of that suit, you do not choose a tile.
sichuan.mchjong.rules.self_draw_bonus.de: On a self-drawn win, each opponent who has not yet won pays this amount in addition to the base score.
A declared kong is scored as Kong. Four identical tiles that have not been declared as a kong are scored as Root. When disabled, both are scored as Root (including kongs).

sichuan.mchjong.rules.transfer_kong_on_s: Transfer Kong Payments After a Post-Kong Discard Win

When enabled, a win on a discard after a kong transfers the discarder’s payments from the consecutive kongs to the winner. When disabled, only the payment for the final kong is returned to the players who paid it.
